item.title: Opportunity Knocks: 467 Virginia Street
item.description: Here’s a rare real estate opportunity indeed. 467 Virginia Street – a magnificent French chateau style home – is now on the market, listed at $749,000. The 4 bed, 2.5+ bath, 6,723 SF home is considered to be one of the most sensitively preserved homes of this nature in all of Buffalo. item.title: Patience, Persistence, and a Pocket Park on Niagara Street
item.description: I still remember the day that the former Curtis Malting building at 1318 Niagara Street was demolished in 2006. Today, that site is a vacant lot, filled with limitless potential. In recent years, Niagara Street has done an about-face, as it has transitioned from a sleepy street to one that is seeing major real estate and business investments. item.title: 50 Great Restaurants in Buffalo: A City of Immigrants
item.description: In the wake of recent ICE injustices, food critic and Four Bites publisher Andrew Galarneau has released a list of 50 of his favorite immigrant-owned restaurants. His hope is that we all support these businesses, and others, so that we can continue to rightfully call our city, The City of Good Neighbors.
